card.name: Of inside institution and title names
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "of" inside capitalized names of institutes, museums, centers and book titles, such as "Institute of Peace". It also fires on a few other words inside proper names.

modes.label: "of" in organization names
modes.description: The word "of" in the middle of a capitalized institution or title, before the next capitalized noun.

modes.label: Other words inside names
modes.description: A word or number partway through an address, group name or field name.
modes.example: National Society of<< Black>> Engineers-MIT established.
